ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the synchronous clock used by all clocked processes and instantiated FIFOs. It times register updates across bus_access, irq_generator, clock_generator, phase_generator and twi_engine processes and is passed to FIFO instances.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in processes bus_access, irq_generator, clock_generator, phase_generator, twi_engine; clk_i mapped to FIFO instances (port map)

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides synchronous/asynchronous reset to all clocked processes and instantiated FIFOs. When asserted low it drives initial reset values for control, engine, clk_gen and io_con registers and is passed to FIFO instances.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... reset branches in multiple processes; rstn_i passed to FIFO instances (port map)

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Carries bus request fields into the controller. Its fields (stb, rw, addr, data, ...) are read by bus_access and by FIFO control logic to start transfers and write FIFO data.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then ... in bus_access process; bus_req_i.data used for ctrl fields and fifo.tx_wdata; bus_req_i fields used in conditional expressions

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Supplies the address bits used to select register vs FIFO access. addr(2) gates whether control registers or RX FIFO are accessed in bus_access and in FIFO write/read enables.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '0') then ... else ... in bus_access; used in conditional expressions selecting data path

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Provides write data bits used to update control registers and to form TX FIFO write words. Slices of data are captured into ctrl fields and into fifo.tx_wdata on bus writes.
role: sources control and FIFO write fields
ports.evidence: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c); fifo.tx_wdata <= bus_req_i.data(dcmd_cmd_hi_c downto dcmd_lsb_c) in bus_access and concurrent assignment

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared in the request bundle but not referenced anywhere in this source file. It carries no influence on the module's behaviour here.

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates a valid bus transaction. It gates bus_access branches, drives bus_rsp_o.ack, and participates in expressions that form FIFO write/read enables.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then ... in bus_access; fifo.tx_we and fifo.rx_re use (bus_req_i.stb = '1') in when expressions; bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Selects read versus write bus access. It controls whether control registers are written or read and gates FIFO read/write enables in concurrent logic.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then ... else ... in bus_access; used in FIFO enable when expressions

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the bus request bundle but not referenced in this source. It does not affect behaviour here.

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Part of the request bundle but not used in this module's logic; present only in declaration.

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced anywhere in this source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared in the bundle but unused in this source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Part of the request bundle but not used in logic here.

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared in the request bundle and not referenced in this source file.

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared but not read or used in any process in this entity.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Provides bus response signals (ack, err, data) driven in the clocked bus_access process. Its fields are assigned from request strobes, constants and internal status (ctrl, fifo, engine).
ports.evidence: Assignments to bus_rsp_o fields in bus_access process: ack, err, data bits set from ctrl fields, fifo signals and constants

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: At each rising clock edge sets ack equal to bus_req_i.stb; reports request acknowledgement to the bus master.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb inside bus_access process at rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Driven to '0' inside the bus_access clocked process on every cycle; reports no error from this module.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' in bus_access process at rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Holds readback data assigned in bus_access: control register fields, FIFO size constant, sense bits and FIFO/engine status, or RX FIFO read data when addressed accordingly; driven at clock edges.
role: reports internal registers and FIFO data
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(...) assigned from ctrl fields and fifo.rx_rdata in bus_access process branches

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.functionality: Continuously reflects the internal ctrl.enable signal to the outside world. It is a direct combinational drive from the control enable register.

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.functionality: Provides an external vector whose selected bit (indexed by ctrl.prsc) is sampled in the clock_generator process to decide when to increment the clk_gen counter and possibly assert tick.
role: indexed by ctrl.prsc to gate tick

ports.name: twi_sda_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the external SDA pin level which is converted and assigned to io_con.sda_in; that sampled input is then used by the engine (shift-in and sense).

ports.name: twi_sda_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external SDA pin continuously from the internal io_con.sda_out register value.

ports.name: twi_scl_i
ports.functionality: Supplying the external SCL pin level which is converted to std_ulogic and stored in io_con.scl_in for use by the engine and halt logic.

ports.name: twi_scl_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external SCL pin from the internal io_con.scl_out register value, used by the TWI engine to toggle the clock line.

ports.name: irq_o
ports.functionality: Reports an interrupt level driven in a clocked process from internal status: asserted when enabled and TX FIFO full and engine not busy (evaluated each clock).
ports.evidence: irq_o <= ctrl.enable and (not fifo.tx_avail) and (not engine.busy) in irq_generator process at rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds the controller configuration (enable, prsc, cdiv, clkstr). Fields are captured from bus write data on bus_access and reported back on reads; they govern clock and engine behaviour.
signals.evidence: ctrl fields assigned in bus_access process from bus_req_i.data; bus_rsp_o.data reads ctrl fields

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.functionality: Captured from bus_req_i.data on bus writes and reset to '0'. It gates clock generation, sets engine.state(2), drives clkgen_en_o and is used in irq generation.
signals.evidence: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in bus_access; used in clock_generator, phase_generator and twi_engine (engine.state(2) <= ctrl.enable)

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes; used as an index into clkgen_i to select which external bit gates the internal clock counter. Reported back on bus reads.
signals.evidence: ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c) in bus_access; used as index in clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc)))

signals.name: ctrl.cdiv
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes; compared to clk_gen.cnt in the clock_generator process to determine when to assert clk_gen.tick. Reported on bus reads.
signals.evidence: ctrl.cdiv <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cdiv3_c downto ctrl_cdiv0_c) in bus_access; compared in clock_generator: if (clk_gen.cnt = ctrl.cdiv) then

signals.name: ctrl.clkstr
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and reported back. When set it participates in halt generation: if slave holds SCL low while SCL out high, clk_gen.halt is asserted and phase rotation is prevented.
signals.evidence: ctrl.clkstr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_clkstr_en_c) in bus_access; used in clk_gen.halt concurrent assignment

signals.name: fifo
signals.functionality: Groups FIFO control and data wires connecting internal logic to instantiated TX/RX FIFOs, including clear, we/re, wdata/rdata, avail and free signals.
signals.evidence: fifo record declared and individual fields used throughout, and connected to FIFO instances in port maps

signals.name: fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combinationally driven as the inverse of ctrl.enable. Sent to both FIFO instances' clear_i inputs to clear or release the FIFOs.
signals.evidence: fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable (concurrent); mapped to clear_i in FIFO instance port maps

signals.name: fifo.rx_we
signals.functionality: Driven directly from engine.done so that RX FIFO receives a write enable when the engine completes a reception. Connected to rx_fifo.we_i port.
signals.evidence: fifo.rx_we <= engine.done (concurrent); rx_fifo port map: we_i => fifo.rx_we

signals.name: fifo.tx_we
signals.functionality: Combinationally asserted when a bus write to the TX FIFO region is detected (stb=1,rw=1,addr(2)=1). Drives the TX FIFO instance write enable input.
signals.evidence: fifo.tx_we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'; mapped to tx_fifo.we_i

signals.name: fifo.rx_re
signals.functionality: Combinational read-enable for the RX FIFO, asserted on a bus read to the FIFO region (stb=1,rw=0,addr(2)=1). Connected to rx_fifo.re_i.
signals.evidence: fifo.rx_re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'; rx_fifo port map

signals.name: fifo.tx_re
signals.functionality: Combinationally asserted to pop a TX FIFO entry when the engine is idle, TX FIFO has data and a clk_gen.tick occurs. Drives the TX FIFO re_i input.
signals.evidence: fifo.tx_re <= '1' when (engine.busy = '0') and (fifo.tx_avail = '1') and (clk_gen.tick = '1') else '0'

signals.name: fifo.rx_wdata
signals.functionality: Forms the 9-bit RX FIFO write word by concatenating the LSB of engine.sreg with the remaining bits; provided to the RX FIFO instance as wdata_i.
signals.evidence: fifo.rx_wdata <= engine.sreg(0) & engine.sreg(8 downto 1); mapped to rx_fifo.wdata_i

signals.name: fifo.rx_rdata
signals.functionality: Receives 9-bit data from the RX FIFO instance rdata_o and is read out to the bus (bus_rsp_o.data) when requested.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo port map: rdata_o => fifo.rx_rdata; bus_access assigns bus_rsp_o.data(8 downto 0) <= fifo.rx_rdata

signals.name: fifo.tx_wdata
signals.functionality: Carries 11-bit TX FIFO write words derived from bus_req_i.data slices and provides them to the TX FIFO instance wdata_i when tx_we asserts.
signals.evidence: fifo.tx_wdata <= bus_req_i.data(dcmd_cmd_hi_c downto dcmd_lsb_c); mapped to tx_fifo.wdata_i

signals.name: fifo.tx_rdata
signals.functionality: Receives 11-bit words from the TX FIFO instance rdata_o and is sampled by the engine when it consumes a TX entry.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo port map: rdata_o => fifo.tx_rdata; used in twi_engine when loading engine.sreg <= fifo.tx_rdata(...)

signals.name: fifo.rx_avail
signals.functionality: Driven by the RX FIFO instance to indicate RX data available. Read by bus read logic and reported in bus_rsp_o.data.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo port map: avail_o => fifo.rx_avail; bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_rx_avail_c) <= fifo.rx_avail

signals.name: fifo.tx_avail
signals.functionality: Driven by the TX FIFO instance to indicate TX entries are present. It gates engine fetches (fifo.tx_re) and contributes to the busy/status reporting and irq logic.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo port map: avail_o => fifo.tx_avail; used in twi_engine and fifo.tx_re expression and irq_generator

signals.name: fifo.rx_free
signals.functionality: Driven by the RX FIFO instance to indicate free space. Present but not used elsewhere in this source except as an instance output.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo port map: free_o => fifo.rx_free; no other references

signals.name: fifo.tx_free
signals.functionality: Driven by the TX FIFO instance to indicate free space. Read back on bus reads to show TX fullness (inverted for tx_full).
signals.evidence: tx_fifo port map: free_o => fifo.tx_free; bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_tx_full_c) <= not fifo.tx_free

signals.name: clk_gen
signals.functionality: Groups clock generation registers and signals (cnt, tick, halt, phase_gen, phase_gen_ff, phase). Controls when engine steps occur and provides phased signals used by the TWI engine.
role: connects to engine and phase logic
signals.evidence: clk_gen record declared and individual fields driven in clock_generator, phase_generator and concurrent assignments

signals.name: clk_gen.cnt
signals.functionality: Counts selected clock gating events (when clkgen_i indexed bit is '1') and resets to zero when it equals ctrl.cdiv; its equality with ctrl.cdiv causes clk_gen.tick to be asserted.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.cnt updated in clock_generator process; compared: if (clk_gen.cnt = ctrl.cdiv) then clk_gen.tick <= '1'

signals.name: clk_gen.tick
signals.functionality: Pulses for one clock when the divider counter reaches ctrl.cdiv while the selected clkgen_i bit is '1'. Used to trigger FIFO pops and phase rotation.
role: triggers FIFO reads and phase rotation
signals.evidence: clk_gen.tick set when (clk_gen.cnt = ctrl.cdiv) and clkgen_i(...) = '1' in clock_generator; used in fifo.tx_re expression and phase_generator

signals.name: clk_gen.halt
signals.functionality: Combinationally asserted when SCL is held low by a slave (io_con.scl_out='1' and io_con.scl_in_ff(1)='0') and ctrl.clkstr is enabled; it prevents phase rotation when asserted.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.halt <= '1' when (io_con.scl_out = '1') and (io_con.scl_in_ff(1) = '0') and (ctrl.clkstr = '1') else '0'; used in phase_generator condition

signals.name: clk_gen.phase_gen
signals.functionality: Holds the rotating one-hot vector that advances when enabled and ticked; reinitialised to "0001" when disabled or engine not busy, and shifted under tick when not halted.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.phase_gen <= ... inside phase_generator process; clk_gen.phase_gen_ff <= clk_gen.phase_gen also in phase_generator

signals.name: clk_gen.phase_gen_ff
signals.functionality: Captures the previous cycle's phase_gen value each clock edge to derive edge-detected phase signals (phase = phase_gen_ff AND not phase_gen).
signals.evidence: clk_gen.phase_gen_ff <= clk_gen.phase_gen in phase_generator process; used in concurrent phase assignments

signals.name: clk_gen.phase
signals.functionality: Four combinational phase strobes derived from the previous and current phase generator vectors (phase_gen_ff AND not phase_gen). They are used by the TWI engine to time SDA/SCL transitions and sampling.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.phase(i) <= clk_gen.phase_gen_ff(i) and (not clk_gen.phase_gen(i)) concurrent assignments; used in twi_engine case branches

signals.name: engine
signals.functionality: Contains the TWI engine state, bit counter, shift register and done flag. State machine logic updates these registers synchronously in twi_engine to perform bus transfers and to feed FIFOs.
signals.evidence: engine record declared; fields assigned in twi_engine process and used elsewhere (engine.busy concurrent)

signals.name: engine.state
signals.functionality: Three-bit state register forming the engine's state machine. Bit 2 is set from ctrl.enable; bits 1:0 are updated in the state machine to sequence start/stop, driving engine activity and reads/writes.
signals.evidence: engine.state(2) <= ctrl.enable in twi_engine; case engine.state is ... updates engine.state(1 downto 0)

signals.name: engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Counts bits transferred during a byte/frame; initialized and incremented in the engine state machine; compared to "1001" to detect end-of-byte and trigger done.
signals.evidence: engine.bitcnt updated in twi_engine case "111" with increments and comparisons to "1001"

signals.name: engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Holds the byte being transmitted or the received bits. Loaded from fifo.tx_rdata when starting a transfer and shifted in/out during phases; partially used to form fifo.rx_wdata.
signals.evidence: engine.sreg <= fifo.tx_rdata(dcmd_msb_c downto dcmd_lsb_c) & (not fifo.tx_rdata(dcmd_ack_c)) in state "100"; fifo.rx_wdata <= engine.sreg(0) & engine.sreg(8 downto 1)

signals.name: engine.done
signals.functionality: A synchronous one-cycle flag asserted by the engine when a byte/frame transmission completes; used to write RX FIFO (fifo.rx_we) and cleared each clock in the engine process.
signals.evidence: engine.done <= '1' when end condition in state "111"; engine.done <= '0' set at top of twi_engine rising_edge

signals.name: engine.busy
signals.functionality: Combinationally derived to indicate the engine is active when state(2) is set and the low bits are not "00". It is used in status reporting and gating engine-related logic.
role: used in irq and fetch gating
signals.evidence: engine.busy <= '1' when (engine.state(2) = '1') and (engine.state(1 downto 0) /= "00") else '0'; used in bus_rsp_o.data and irq_generator and fifo.tx_re condition

signals.name: io_con
signals.functionality: Groups sampled inputs and driven outputs for SDA and SCL (sda_in_ff, scl_in_ff, sda_in, scl_in, sda_out, scl_out). These connect physical pins to the engine and to clk_gen.halt logic.
role: supplies inputs for halt and sensing
signals.evidence: io_con record declared and fields used in twi_engine, concurrent I/O assignments and clk_gen.halt

signals.name: io_con.sda_in_ff
signals.functionality: Two-stage shift register sampling the SDA input (io_con.sda_in) on each clock edge to provide synchronized, debounced input bits used by the engine and reported via bus reads.
signals.evidence: io_con.sda_in_ff <= io_con.sda_in_ff(0) & io_con.sda_in in twi_engine process; bus_rsp_o.data reads io_con.sda_in_ff(1)

signals.name: io_con.scl_in_ff
signals.functionality: Two-stage shift register sampling the SCL input to provide synchronized SCL values used for sensing and for clk_gen.halt decision and reported on bus reads.
signals.evidence: io_con.scl_in_ff <= io_con.scl_in_ff(0) & io_con.scl_in in twi_engine; bus_rsp_o.data reads io_con.scl_in_ff(1); clk_gen.halt uses io_con.scl_in_ff(1)

signals.name: io_con.sda_in
signals.functionality: Converted from the external twi_sda_i pin and provided to the SDA input sampler shift register. It is driven by the concurrent conversion expression.
signals.evidence: io_con.sda_in <= to_stdulogic(to_bit(twi_sda_i)); io_con.sda_in used in twi_engine assignment to io_con.sda_in_ff

signals.name: io_con.scl_in
signals.functionality: Converted from external twi_scl_i and provided to the SCL input sampler. Used in the engine and in halt detection logic.
signals.evidence: io_con.scl_in <= to_stdulogic(to_bit(twi_scl_i)); used in twi_engine assignment to io_con.scl_in_ff and clk_gen.halt

signals.name: io_con.sda_out
signals.functionality: Register controlling the driven level of SDA (twi_sda_o). Updated by the engine state machine depending on phase signals and bit positions; exported to the external SDA pin.
signals.evidence: io_con.sda_out <= '1' in reset and updated in twi_engine case branches; twi_sda_o <= io_con.sda_out

signals.name: io_con.scl_out
signals.functionality: Register controlling the driven SCL level (twi_scl_o). Set by the engine at specific phases to generate clock transitions and used in clk_gen.halt computation.
signals.evidence: io_con.scl_out initialized in reset and updated in twi_engine case branches; twi_scl_o <= io_con.scl_out and clk_gen.halt uses io_con.scl_out
